name: chill-food
title: Chill food
signature: chill(food: object_ref, appliance: appliance_ref, temp_c: number)
description: Keep food in the closed refrigerator until it is at or below a target temperature.
use_when: Food or a drink must cool in the refrigerator.

not_to_be_confused_with.heat: opposite direction, with the microwave or stove.

food.description: The food item with thermal state.

preconditions.name: in_appliance
preconditions.meaning: Object centre inside the appliance cavity box (microwave) or body box (refrigerator).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

preconditions.name: is_closed
preconditions.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: temperature_at_most
postconditions.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or below the threshold.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: temperature_at_most
checks.meaning: Task-level food temperature at or below the threshold.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

previous.when: the fridge must be closed while cooling

next.when: the chilled food is taken out

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
